critical_code_review_comments: ENV/Infra: Redis was FATAL in supervisor at the start of this iter — /usr/bin/redis-server binary was missing (likely lost when container was forked). Installed via `apt-get install -y redis-server` and `sudo supervisorctl start redis`; after restart cache works as expected. Recommend adding redis-server to the base image / Dockerfile so this doesn't recur on next clean spawn.

cache.py:192 — `value['cached']=True; value['served_at']=...` mutates the deserialized dict before returning. Since the JSON is freshly parsed each warm hit there is no aliasing risk, but a future optimization that returns a shared object would surface this. Not blocking.

tenant_debts_routes.py key_fn — uses `lambda only_with_debt=True,...: f'v={int(bool(only_with_debt))}'`. The default-arg trick relies on FastAPI passing query params as kwargs (it does). Slightly opaque; a named helper would read better.

seed_platform_card_sales.py — sells with `is_credit=method=='credit'` but `debt_amount=sell` only when credit; consistent. No tenant-side recompute hook triggered for the seeded credit rows, so credit-debt cache won't reflect them until a real settle event — acceptable for a pagination QA seed.

Frontend pagination footer renders even when total<=50 in the conditional? Verified: yes, only renders when has_more or page>0 (line 389 wraps in {(salesHasMore || salesPage>0) && ...}); footer correctly hidden for tenants without seed data, visible for seeded tenant.

rca of the issue: No application bugs. One environmental gotcha: redis-server binary was missing from the container so the Redis supervisor program was in FATAL state, which made @cached_json fall back to NoopCache. Resolution: installed redis-server via apt-get and started it via supervisorctl — all cache-related tests passed afterward. Suggest baking redis-server into the base image.
